sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Taylor Ellis.
Taylor Ellis worked as an evidence technician and is also listed as the contact for AFPD property-disposal notices in 2026.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Transparent Utah records list Taylor Ellis's work for American Fork from fiscal year 2019 through 2021. The latest listed position is Evidence Technician.
These years are based on reported pay, not exact hire or departure dates. The last payroll entry alone does not confirm when the employment ended.

Although the saved compensation records end in 2021, official Utah public notices still list Taylor Ellis as AFPD's property-disposal contact in 2026. Those notices establish a continuing department connection, but do not specify a current job title.
